method: Complete pinned SConstruct read with Git/SHA256 verification; original AST archive/sanitizer helper functions executed with stub subprocess.
findings: build_tar_gz ignores subprocess.call return and always prints Wrote tarball. Original control with archive return128 returns None and prints success. No actual archive, deletion or release action performed.
Release mode explicitly defines G_DISABLE_ASSERT and NDEBUG; DEBUG adds RM_DEBUG and fno-inline. Sanitizers do not imply DEBUG, so sanitizer builds may still omit assertions.

Environment flags are merged again after project defaults, then command-line CCFLAGS appended. Effective configuration may override optimization or assertions; summary prints requested mode, not all final compiler semantics.
Sanitizer shorthand matches lowercase literals before lowercasing fallback: true yields address/undefined/leak while TRUE yields unsupported-looking true entry. Compiler acceptance not executed.
Prefix record is written before installation succeeds and when not staged; it records intent, not confirmed installed artifacts. install-lib is intentionally outside installing flag.
show-config -n deliberately enables configure actions temporarily, then restores dryrun. Treat this target as potentially running compile probes, not wholly read-only inspection.
Staged prefix strips absolute root before joining DESTDIR. Explicit uninstall helpers still reference PREFIX paths and full uninstall semantics remain unexecuted.
Build uses get_cpu_count directly for default jobs, while explicit -j is documented to override. No independent positive validation visible at this call site.
Tests SConscript is loaded but full suite execution requires its target; configuration, default build or feature summary is not upstream runtime proof.
Compiler/feature checks precede final Werror/debug/optimization/sanitizer/custom flags; successful probes do not prove final effective build configuration.

executed_control.scope: Original extracted functions; subprocess stub only, no git archive or build executed.

limits: No upstream configure/build/release execution or production-code optimization in this audit.
